verdict.rationale: Motion documents several built-in AI features that do work on the user's behalf: an AI Meeting Notetaker that takes notes and follows up on action items, an AI Search Assistant, an AI Workflow Builder that builds workflows from SOPs, and AI scheduling that places and reshuffles tasks automatically. However, the evidence shows no general-purpose in-product assistant the user can hand arbitrary tasks to, and the AI features are only listed in marketing copy without depth. missing for 10: evidence of a general agent that accepts and executes delegated tasks, documentation of what the assistant can do autonomously, independent or hands-on corroboration.
